facts.fact: Usha told Queen Nirmala of Neela's coming raid on the chest on the day she gave Neela the landing count, before the theft. The unlocked chest (F858) was the queen's deliberate answer. Usha reported the shed vote to her last night after the lamp.
The spray slot in the sea stair roof was left by the queen's grandfather's masons; the queen has meant to close it for thirty years and never did.
The queen says she has not caged any of her own in thirty years, and that she has made a promise to her own people which she may not break. Neela is told to ask about it later, not today.
The queen is in the drying shed at noon and so misses her noon audience (F835).
Neela feels the noon gun as a blow through the shed barrel and takes it for a cart on the quay, only realising afterwards that it was the gun.
